verdict.rationale: The evidence documents automatic meeting summaries, action items and decisions, but nothing shows Fellow drafting a follow-up email for review and sending. Passing transcripts to an LLM through the API, or querying recaps through the MCP server with an external chatbot, are developer building blocks and user-side workarounds rather than the product's own email-drafting capability.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
